executive_summary: The Indian stock market experienced a decline, with Nifty and Sensex falling amid mixed sector performance, while the US stock market gained momentum driven by Big Tech earnings. Global markets are reacting to the Strait of Hormuz blockade, and the US government is exerting control over AI model access, with Microsoft and Google facing challenges in AI coding. These developments are driving a macroeconomic rethink, with inflation and GDP concerns at the forefront.
